curated.description: Curated skills maintained by the core team

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Helps execute implementation plans and track progress through multi-step development tasks.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like 'how do I do X', 'find a skill for X', 'is there a skill that can...', or express interest in extending capabilities.

skills.name: image-generation
skills.description: Provides tools and workflows for generating images using various AI image generation APIs.

skills.name: pdf-generation
skills.description: Comprehensive PDF generation capabilities including document creation, formatting, and conversion from markdown.

skills.name: planning-with-files
skills.description: Enables systematic planning with file-based session management, progress tracking, and task coordination.

skills.name: powershell-windows
skills.description: Provides Windows-specific PowerShell commands and workflows for system administration and automation tasks.

skills.name: skill-auditor
skills.description: Validates and audits skills to ensure they meet quality standards, proper structure, and best practices.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: A tool to install skills from remote git repositories directly into the .trae/skills directory. Supports subdirectories for monorepo skill collections.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Provides systematic approaches to debugging complex issues, including root cause analysis, condition-based waiting, and defense-in-depth strategies.

skills.name: template-skill
skills.description: A template skill that demonstrates the proper structure and format for creating new skills.

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.description: Advanced UI/UX design capabilities including design systems, accessibility, and user experience optimization.

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.description: Helps users leverage advanced AI capabilities and superpowers for enhanced productivity and problem-solving.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Guides the creation of detailed implementation plans, breaking down complex projects into actionable steps.
